readinessConditions.condition: Bound every selected TEXT field in SQL by bytes, including identifiers/generation/header/turn payloads; use SQLite CAST-AS-BLOB length and PostgreSQL octet_length, bounded invalid sentinels, private refusal and actual NUL-prefixed SQLite corruption oracles.

Use explicit bytewise owner equality and identical keyset order/comparisons; require well-formed UTF-8-roundtrippable/non-NUL discovery inputs and I2-consumable stored IDs/generation with existing nonblank 128 UTF-16-unit bounds, without changing H/worker contracts.
Enforce 131072 UTF-8 bytes for the whole serialized result and exercise worst-case escaping/multibyte fields at limit 50.

Use dedicated single-statement metadata SQL rather than project listing/runtime/H reads; cursor positions require no existence/ownership lookup. Preserve empty filtered-page progress and missing/corrupt-header refusal. Inspect actual index/query plans and many-row samples without no-sort/fixed-scan claims or an unapproved index/migration.

paginationAssessment: Raw scanned rows, including terminal/waiting rows, advance keyset; empty candidate pages may continue. Lookahead only determines raw hasMore; nextCursor is the last scanned position or null at end. No snapshot/notification/exactly-once/fair-scheduling guarantee.
hintAssessment: Submitted/preparing/approved metadata is potential work only. Approved terminal runs may remain hinted; I2 must recheck ownership/generation/run/deadline/leases before any dispatch or edit. No reconciliation or private run payload read is authorized.
